topic: Only the orch binaries beside orchd are protected
detail: From the RC-110 security review (low): spaces.GuardProtection protects orch, orchd and orch-hook in the directory orchd runs from (under brew services /opt/homebrew/opt/orch/bin, whose links resolve to the same Cellar files as the bin/orch-hook link harness settings run, so writes through either are refused). An orch-hook installed elsewhere (orch install --bin-dir) is not protected, and moving the whole directory that holds the settings' link (mv /opt/homebrew/bin ...) and planting a new orch-hook is not refused. Proposed: protect the hook command path orch install writes into harness settings (recorded at install, or read from the settings when the snapshot is written).
